blocks.text: Python mein try block ke andar woh code rakha jata hai jis mein ghalti aa sakti hai, aur except block ghalti aane par usay sambhalta hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"a = int(input("Enter a number: "))": user se number likhwata hai aur int() usay poore number (integer) mein badalta hai.
"try :": jis line mein ghalti aa sakti hai woh try ke andar hai.
"result =10/a": 10 ko a se divide karta hai; a 0 ho to ZeroDivisionError aata hai. Isi line par # wala hissa comment hai.
"except ZeroDivisionError:": yeh ghalti pakar kar program ko crash hone se bachata hai.
"print("You can’t divide by zero!")": message print hota hai; kitab ne can’t mein tirchha apostrophe (’) chhapa hai, string ke andar Python isay qubool karti hai aur waise hi print karti hai.
Output: 0 likhne par "Enter a number: " ke baad "You can’t divide by zero!" aata hai. Koi aur number (maslan 5) likhne par kuch print nahi hota, kyunke result bana to hai magar print nahi kiya gaya.
Number ki jagah koi word likhein to int() wali pehli line hi ValueError deti hai aur program ruk jata hai, kyunke woh line try ke bahar hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab pehli line "Input a" chhapti hai; yeh Python nahi (SyntaxError). Number lene ke liye: a = int(input("Enter a number: ")).

blocks.prompt: User 0 likhe to program kya print karta hai, aur 5 likhe to?
blocks.explanation: 0 par "You can't divide by zero!"; 5 par kuch nahi, kyunke result = 2.0 baghair ghalti nikalta hai magar print nahi hota.

blocks.text: Yahan input() ki jagah a ki value seedhi likhi hai. a ko 0 rakh kar aur phir 5 kar ke Run karein: 0 par except block chalta hai, warna result print hota hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"a = 0": input() ki jagah value seedhi likhi hai.
"try:": ghalti wala code try mein.
"result = 10 / a": a 0 hai, is liye yahan ZeroDivisionError aata hai aur agli line (print) chhoot jati hai.
"except ZeroDivisionError:": ghalti pakri jati hai aur us ka message print hota hai.
Output: You can't divide by zero!
Khud try karein: a = 5 kar ke Run karein: koi ghalti nahi, "Result: 2.0" aayega (/ se divide ka jawab hamesha decimal mein aata hai).

items: try: woh code jis mein ghalti ka khatra ho; except: ghalti aaye to kya karna hai.
